commits.subject: core: keep numeric parsing in ASM and share aligned SSSE3 data
commits.body:
Continue long mantissas and exponents from the SIMD prefix and handle
uncommon grammar and CPUs without SSSE3 in scalar ASM. Preserve the Pascal
reference's rounding, errors, JSON cursor and Integer/Int64/Currency rules.

Share 944 bytes of SIMD constants between both parsers, with explicit
16-byte alignment independent of Delphi's typed-constant layout. Add
regressions for alignment, the 16-byte boundary, long exponents and suffixes.

Validated Delphi 12.2 Win64 and FPC 3.2.2 Win64/Linux, Release and Debug:
upstream core tests, four rounding modes, independent decimal checks,
memory boundaries, FPU/ABI, scalar dispatch and exchange JSON parsing.
commits.author: Mike

commits.subject: core: accelerate Delphi Win64 number parsing with SSSE3
commits.body:
Reduce short digit sequences in parallel while preserving JSON result types,
exact Currency payloads, cursors, errors and Pascal rounding order. Reuse POW10
and compact byte-shuffle masks instead of the Eisel-Lemire power table.
Keep Pascal for other compilers, CPUs, page boundaries and uncommon inputs.
commits.author: Mike

files.patch:
@@ -6725,7 +6725,12 @@ function GetExtended(P: PUtf8Char): TSynExtended;
 
 {$ifndef WIN32DELPHI} // Delphi has its own x86/x87 asm version
 
+{$if defined(WIN64DELPHI) and defined(ASMX64)}
+function GetExtendedPascal(P: PUtf8Char; out err: integer): TSynExtended;
+{$else}
 function GetExtended(P: PUtf8Char; out err: integer): TSynExtended;
+{$ifend}
+
 const
   Scale: double = 1.3407807929942597e154; // 2^512
   InvScale: double = 7.458340731200207e-155; // 2^-512
@@ -6917,6 +6922,325 @@ function GetExtended(P: PUtf8Char; out err: integer): TSynExtended;
     result := -result;
 end;
 
+{$if defined(WIN64DELPHI) and defined(ASMX64)}
+const
+  NUMERIC_SSSE3_BYTE = ord(cfSSSE3) shr 3;
+  NUMERIC_SSSE3_MASK = 1 shl (ord(cfSSSE3) and 7);
+
+// SSSE3 digit reduction, adapted from MoonBot's JS4 scanner.
+// Read 16 bytes only when P..P+16 stay within one 4 KiB page. Digit masks
+// locate the dot/terminator; PSHUFB and PMADDUBSW/PMADDWD combine exact
+// integer groups. Small positional tables contain byte controls, not powers.
+// Other CPUs, long inputs and uncommon grammar use the Pascal implementation.
+// REP BSF is TZCNT when available; its nonzero operand also works with BSF.
+function GetExtended(P: PUtf8Char; out err: integer): TSynExtended;
+asm .noframe
+        test    rcx, rcx
+        jz      GetExtendedPascal        // nil: the scalar answers
+        test    byte ptr [rip + CpuFeatures + NUMERIC_SSSE3_BYTE], NUMERIC_SSSE3_MASK
+        je      GetExtendedPascal        // CPU without SSSE3: arguments untouched (r11 is not set yet)
+        xor     r11d, r11d
+        cmp     byte ptr [rcx], '-'
+        jne     @positive
+        inc     rcx
+        inc     r11d
+@positive:
+        mov     eax, ecx
+        and     eax, 4095
+        cmp     eax, 4079
+        ja      @fallback               // 17 bytes must stay inside the page (16 read + terminator)
+        movdqu  xmm0, [rcx]
+        movdqa  xmm1, xmm0
+        paddb   xmm1, [rip + @bias]
+        pcmpgtb xmm1, [rip + @threshold] // digit lanes
+        pmovmskb eax, xmm1
+        not     eax                      // non-digit lanes; bits 16..31 are sentinels
+        db      $f3                      // TZCNT, or BSF without BMI1: same result for nonzero input
+        bsf     r8d, eax                 // p: first non-digit = integer digit count
+        test    r8d, r8d
+        jz      @fallback                // no leading digit
+        cmp     r8d, 15
+        ja      @fallback                // 16+ digits
+        psubb   xmm0, [rip + @ascii0]
+        movzx   r9d, byte ptr [rcx + r8] // byte after the integer digits: dot or terminator
+        cmp     r9d, '.'
+        je      @fraction
+        mov     dword ptr [rdx], 0
+        test    r9d, r9d
+        jz      @integerGo               // NUL: complete number
+        or      r9d, 32
+        cmp     r9d, 'e'
+        je      @integerExponent         // exponent: parsed here, no restart
+        mov     dword ptr [rdx], 1       // any other byte (quote, comma...): partial value, err = 1
+@integerGo:
+        mov     r10d, r8d                // p
+        shl     r8d, 4
+        lea     r9, [rip + @ctrlInt]
+        pshufb  xmm0, [r9 + r8]          // integer: right-aligned, other lanes zero
+        pmaddubsw xmm0, [rip + @ten]

commits.subject: core: fix empty numbers, padded decimals and negative fraction boundaries
commits.body:
Reject input without digits and remove trailing zeros that prevent exact
Clinger operands. Count the boundary fractional digit at magnitude 2^63,
preserve the minimum Currency value, and recognize zero before range checks.
Add independent bit-exact regressions to NumericalConversions.
commits.author: Mike
